contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	precondition:
		let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User|x.UserID = uid),c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y: BookCopy|y.Barcode = barcode) in
		User.allInstances()->one(u1: User|u1.UserID = uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->one(c1: BookCopy|c1.Barcode = barcode) and
		u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
		u.SuspensionDays = 0 and
		(Student.allInstances()->exists(s: Student|s.UserID = uid and
		s.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR and
		s.LoanedNumber<20) or
		Student.allInstances()->exists(s: Student|s.UserID = uid and
		s.Programme = Programme::MASTER and
		s.LoanedNumber<40) or
		Student.allInstances()->exists(s: Student|s.UserID = uid and
		s.Programme<>Programme::BACHELOR and
		s.Programme<>Programme::MASTER and
		s.LoanedNumber<60) or
		Faculty.allInstances()->exists(f: Faculty|f.UserID = uid and
		f.LoanedNumber<60)) and
		(c.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
		(c.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and
		c.IsReserved = true and
		c.ReservationRecord->exists(r: Reserve|r.ReservedUser = u and
		r.IsReserveClosed = false)))
	postcondition:
		let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User|x.UserID = uid),c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y: BookCopy|y.Barcode = barcode) in
		let l: Loan in
		l.oclIsNew() and
		Loan.allInstances()->includes(l) and
		l.LoanedUser = u and
		l.LoanedCopy = c and
		l.IsReturned = false and
		l.LoanDate = Today and
		l.ReturnDate = null and
		l.RenewedTimes = 0 and
		l.OverDueFee = 0.0 and
		l.OverDue3Days = false and
		l.OverDue10Days = false and
		l.OverDue17Days = false and
		l.OverDue31Days = false and
		u.LoanedBook->includes(l) and
		c.LoanedRecord->includes(l) and
		if Student.allInstances()->exists(s: Student|s.UserID = uid) 
		then l.DueDate = Today.After(30) 
		else l.DueDate = Today.After(60) 
		endif  and
		u.LoanedNumber = u.LoanedNumber@pre+1 and
		c.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
		if c.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF 
		then c.IsReserved = false and
		c.ReservationRecord->exists(r: Reserve|r.ReservedUser.UserID = uid and
		r.IsReserveClosed@pre = false and
		r.IsReserveClosed = true) 
		else true 
		endif  and
		result = true
}
